title: HSBC opens HK$100 RedCoin subscriptions to tokenized Hong Kong dollar fund
why_it_matters: The HK$100 entry point brings tokenized fund exposure to smaller retail investors, but its restricted wallets and off-chain ownership register show how banks are combining blockchain records with conventional fund controls.
caption:
RWA WIRE // NEWS

HSBC opens HK$100 RedCoin subscriptions to tokenized Hong Kong dollar fund

HSBC Hong Kong customers can access a tokenized money market fund from HK$100 through RedCoin, while Ethereum records units and the official register remains off-chain.
